integrity: A complete constructive proof, a standalone verifier and the recorded enumeration outputs are supplied; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional unfilled complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts, unique strictly largest part of size >=2. No result claimed for tied largest parts or full strong matching complexes. Finite checks supplement the infinite combinatorial proof. Equivalence to any unindexed literature remains an originality uncertainty.
title: Equivariant deformation retraction and non-shellability of pure strong Morse complexes of unbalanced complete multipartite graphs
